messages.subject: Supply Agreement — Stratton mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our client's mark-up is attached. The principal changes: liability cap increased to 150%; price-review right deleted (prices fixed for the term); minimum-commitment shortfall reduced to 10%; liquidated damages to sit outside the cap; IP indemnity uncapped; and termination for convenience available from day one on three months' notice.

We think these are reasonable given the criticality of supply to our client's sites. Let's set up a call.

Alistair

Pemberton Rowe LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
